title: Our Home
objectives: Spell grade-level sight words from memory when I write
Spot a common spelling pattern (like ‘ight’, ‘ai’, ‘ow’) in a word
Use clues from the sentence to guess what a new word means
Use prepositions: in, on, under, between, next to
Find an example or detail in the text to back up my answer
Write a compound sentence with and, but or so

vocabulary.definition: a home on one floor of a tall building
a small place outside a window, high up, where you can sit
vocabulary.example: I watch the birds from my balcony.

vocabulary.definition: a place outside a house with grass, trees and flowers
the room where you wash and have a bath or shower
vocabulary.example: There is a bathtub in the bathroom.

vocabulary.definition: the room where you cook food
vocabulary.example: My mum cooks in the kitchen.

vocabulary.definition: the room where the family sits, talks and watches TV
vocabulary.example: We watch television in the living room.

vocabulary.definition: the room where you eat meals at a big table
vocabulary.example: We eat dinner in the dining room.

vocabulary.definition: the place where you live with your family
on a higher floor of a building
on a lower floor of a building
a long soft seat for two or more people
vocabulary.example: The cat is on the blue sofa.

vocabulary.definition: furniture with legs and a flat top
vocabulary.example: There is a pen under the table.

vocabulary.definition: a green living thing that grows in soil
vocabulary.example: My favourite plant is on the fridge.

vocabulary.definition: a lamp that helps you see in the dark
glass in a wall that lets light in

sentences.text: I watch the birds from my balcony.
There is a bathtub in the bathroom.
We watch television in the living room.
My mum cooks in the kitchen.
The living room is next to the kitchen.
The cat is on the blue sofa.

grammar.title: in, on, under, between, next to
explain: Prepositions tell us WHERE something is.
in = inside. on = on top. under = below.
between = in the middle of two things. next to = beside.
examples: The fridge is in the kitchen.
The cat is on the sofa.
The pen is under the table.
The cup is between the sofa and the plant.
The bag is next to the cat.

practice.prompt: The cat is ___ the sofa. (on top)
The pen is ___ the table. (below)
The cup is ___ the sofa and the plant.
The bathroom is ___ my room and my sister's room.
The living room is ___ to the kitchen.
The milk is ___ the fridge. (inside)
Which word is a preposition?
Put the words in order.
practice.answer: The plant is next to the sofa.

grammar.title: and, but, so
explain: We join two sentences to make one longer sentence.
and adds more. but shows something different. so tells what happens because of it.
Our house is big and it has a garden. / I like the kitchen but I love the garden. / It was hot so we stayed inside.
examples: We have a garden and we play there.
Our home is small but it is cosy.
Mum is in the kitchen so no one hides there.

practice.prompt: We have a balcony ___ I watch the birds there.
Our apartment is small ___ it is cosy.
practice.explain: but shows something different: small, but cosy.

practice.prompt: It was hot ___ we ate inside.
Mum is always in the kitchen ___ no one hides there.
I like the garden ___ I don't like the bathroom.
Put the words in order.
practice.answer: Our house is big and it has a garden.

grammar.title: Spelling patterns: ight, ai, ow
explain: Some letters work together to make one sound.
ai says “ay”: rain, paint. ow can say “oh”: window, snow.

practice.prompt: Which word has the ight pattern?
Which word has the ai pattern?

reading.title: Sara's Apartment
paragraphs: My name is Sara. My family and I live in an apartment on the tenth floor of a tall building. From our balcony, we can see the sea.
Our apartment has three bedrooms, a kitchen, a living room and two bathrooms. My bedroom is between my brother's room and the bathroom.
The living room is next to the kitchen. There is a big green sofa in the living room. My cat, Lulu, likes to sleep on the sofa. Sometimes she hides under the table.
We don't have a garden, so we grow plants on the balcony. Dad waters them every evening. Our home is small but it is cosy, and I love it!
